findings_resolved.resolution: Both child pipe handles are assigned before set_blocking/register. Each pipe and selector close has an independent guarded attempt; close error names are recorded, code is nonzero and final status is HOLD. An ordinary close failure cannot skip the remaining handle, selector attempt or receipt attempt.

Prospective retained-buffer length is checked before extend, so each retained buffer is at most32768B. One at-most4096B just-read chunk may trigger rejection before retention; cap failure is HOLD, not a complete accepted response.

Scope expressly distinguishes no collector credential-file/value inspection or disclosure from normal gh use of existing authorized authentication config. Allowed existing context values are transported unlogged; receipt exposure remains credential-context ENV-key presence only.
Source scope explicitly labels deadlines cooperative, not hard filesystem-IO bounds.

method: Narrow static successor review only. Rehashed preserved v1/canonical successor/prior findings; read entire new unified delta; independently reconstructed successor and predecessor by six exact single-occurrence ordered literal replacements and reverse replacements with whole-byte identity. Accepted unchanged body is reused, not executed or re-audited as a new framework.
preservation: No helper execution/import/AST/compilation, Git, network, process/runtime/SDK probe, build/test, source capture, replay, source promotion or central edit by reviewer. Only own-lane review output is written. Original lock/config, immutable source/index/object evidence, all old R HOLDs, STOP/NO-RETRY/CLOSED/native refusal/protected refs/1017001 and historical terminal gaps remain unchanged.

preserved_predecessor.qualification: Root reports unexecuted v1; retained as source only, not a query receipt or retry authority.

required_actual_interpretation: Root exact one-shot admission and original external terminal result are separately required. A private saved receipt or pending_code cannot alone prove terminal completion, pipe cleanup or child settlement.

Accept actual success only with the exact intended projection, status, zero original terminal/child exits, reaped original child, no close/settlement errors and acceptable caps/deadlines. The cleanup description string is not independent proof if flags/errors or terminal disagree.

POINT_MATCHING_OPEN_PR_REQUIRES_ADMISSION_REASSESSMENT can accompany exit0; it does not permit publication. POINT_NO_MATCHING_OPEN_PR is only one finite exact-branch metadata point, not continuous custody or universal/future synchronize-workflow exclusion.

Executable pins and own namespace values are point observations for later Apple collector binding, not continuous guarantees or automatic Apple invocation authority. No CLI-internal credential behavior audit, SDK/CI result or collector execution is claimed.
Failure consumes this finite attempt without automatic retry. C19 query is consumed and supplies no replay authority; neither retained v1 nor this source review is a fresh GET result.

unchanged_finite_scope.entry: Root must separately admit this exact canonical source and intended /usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S -B entry in its existing authorized context. The helper requires its exact argv and isolated/no-site/no-bytecode flags. It is not the stricter static05 ENV contract.
unchanged_finite_scope.receipts: Exclusive private PR-STATE-INTENT.json and PR-STATE.json under checkpoint20 only; bounded, fsynced, read back. Stderr/raw child response and credential values are not dumped; buffers are represented by byte counts/digests, plus the narrow PR projection.
unchanged_finite_scope.settlement: Original direct child only; conditional kill only while original child remains unreaped, then bounded wait. No process/name/group stop; no abnormal-descendant absence proof. Both child pipes and selector are separately closed/attempted.
